incoming_email.subject: Invoice discrepancy for July
incoming_email.body:
Hi,

I noticed our July invoice shows $2,400 but we're on the Growth plan at $1,800/month. Could you explain the difference?

Is there an overage fee we missed? We need to get this resolved before accounting closes the month.

Thanks,
Sarah

reference_response.subject: Re: Invoice discrepancy for July
reference_response.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thank you for reaching out about this. I've looked into your account and can see the difference is due to the additional 20 user licenses added mid-month.

The prorated cost for these licenses comes to $600. You can view the exact breakdown on page 2 of the attached invoice PDF.

Best regards,
Support Team
